field.name: Product Highlights
field.value: Wide toe-box winter ankle boots with a plush-lined interior and collar for seasonal casual-footwear assortments. Dial-and-cord closure adjusts the upper without tying conventional laces; a heel pull tab provides a grip when putting the boot on. TPR outsole with a pronounced lug pattern, stitched side panels and an ankle-height silhouette. Black and Gray, each in EU 39-48, give buyers two neutral color options and an extended men's size range. Original-style wholesale orders start from 2 pairs. Choose your color-size quantities to request an assortment quotation.
Which colors and sizes can I order?
Black and Gray are offered in EU 39-48. Each color has the full listed size range. Send the quantity for each color and EU size to build your order assortment.
This ankle-height style combines a widened toe box, plush lining and collar, a heel pull tab and a lug-pattern TPR outsole. It is a winter casual-footwear option for your seasonal assortment.
Does this style use ordinary shoelaces?
It uses a rotary dial and cord closure instead of conventional tied laces. The cord runs through guides along the upper, allowing the closure to be adjusted with the dial.
How should I check the fit before a bulk order?

Use the EU size labels for this style. Request the size chart for your target sizes and assess a sample with the socks your customers normally wear. The widened toe-box design makes this a useful option to evaluate for buyers seeking more space at the front.
What is the minimum wholesale order?

The listed minimum for the original style is 2 pairs. Quantity pricing is shown on this page. Include your color-size breakdown in the enquiry; logo or packaging projects receive a separate quotation for their requirements.
How do I request a sample quotation?

Choose Black or Gray and the EU size you want to evaluate, then send your delivery country and postal code. The sample quotation will set out the sample charge, shipping charge and dispatch schedule for that selection.
How can I discuss a logo or retail packaging?

Send your logo artwork, preferred placement and packaging specification with the planned pair quantity. We use these details to review a proposal for this style and quote the applicable order quantity, cost and sample process.
What should I send for a delivered-order quotation?

Send the total pairs, color-size quantities, packaging requirements, delivery country and postal code, and your required arrival date. The quotation can then distinguish product cost, freight and the proposed dispatch schedule for your order.
